name: Global Country Atlas
purpose: Parent container for the country layer. The blueprint defines what every country should contain; the source registry defines where values come from; country records contain only normalized observations and provenance.
inheritance: country -> countries-blueprint -> field definitions -> source registry -> automated refresh -> normalized country record
frontend_rule: Do not expose blueprint instructions as country content. Frontend shows the resulting data, freshness, provenance and meaningful comparisons.
epistemic_boundary: Empirical country statistics remain empirical. Political classifications are sourced or explicitly analytical. Symbolic Tree/Axis/angel/demon material remains project interpretation and is never presented as measured population data.
